categories_thin: Tire shops — A & J Tire Shop is the only independent tyre shop found. Re-checked in the revision with a dedicated 'tire shop Somerset NJ 08873 independent' search and the Cylex automotive category: the rest of the Somerset tyre market is chain or brand-franchised (Goodyear, Mavis, Jiffy Lube) and excluded by the brief.

Towing — Guaranteed Motor, A&G and Rick's are the only township-based operators with a published Somerset address or phone; most others are county-wide or based in neighbouring towns. Re-checked via the Cylex transportation category, which returned courier, taxi and freight firms rather than tow operators.

Self-storage — re-checked on the Cylex storage category in the revision: the township market read as national chains (CubeSmart x3, Extra Space, U-Haul) which the brief excludes, so nothing was listed.

Body shops — Stankovich, Hamilton Auto Body, T & J Auto Body and Any Auto Services (also described as a body shop) were found; the state licensed-facility PDF could only be read in slices, so more likely exist along the Route 27 corridor.

Septic and well — local firms mostly operate out of Montgomery, Hillsborough or Bound Brook and list Franklin Township only as a service area, so they are recorded with 'serves' notes rather than as confirmed in-town businesses.

Locksmiths and garage doors — after removing the pure local-SEO sites in the revision, three records remain (Lock Door Barrier, Not Just Doors, Somerset Garage Door Repair) plus two quarantined ones; the category is dominated by lead-generation listings with no verifiable township shopfront.
Manufacturing/machine shops were seen (Betar, Csepli Machine, Rendas Tool & Die, Jersey Metalworks) but belong to group D, which this zone brief does not cover.
caveats: Franklin Township covers the Somerset (08873), Franklin Park (08823), Middlebush, East Millstone, Griggstown and part of Kingston mailing addresses; entries were kept only where the listing address fell in one of those, and a handful are flagged 'township unconfirmed'.
The entire township sits inside the 10-mile radius from central Milltown, so no part of the zone was dropped on distance grounds.

Exclusion threshold applied consistently in this revision: national carriers, franchise/brand-franchised locations and regional operators with three or more branch locations were dropped, even where an in-zone office or landing page exists. That removed Swim-Mor Pools & Spas (three NJ showrooms; the Somerset page was a service-area page), Appliance Master (multi-branch NJ/eastern PA), Budd Van Lines (national household-goods carrier) and Binsky Home Service (multi-branch NJ home-services company). Single-location local firms with one Somerset or Franklin Park address were kept.

Several kept entries are smaller multi-town or multi-page operations whose only listed base is in-zone or whose listed address is a single local one; these carry notes (e.g. Somerset Garage Door Repair, Master Attic, Lipari Pools, S & R Pool & Spa).
Many directory-sourced entries show only one listing; the triage team should confirm they still trade before outreach.

Two records are retained only as quarantined/unverified (Somerset Garage Door Solutions, Somerset Appliance Repair Men) because they look like keyword lead-generation listings; Estate Locksmith Store and Top Lock Service were removed entirely in this revision for the same reason (no street address, and for Estate Locksmith Store a site that would not load).

Addresses backfilled from BuildZoom (Bush Electrical, Million Electric, High Tech Contractors) come from search results that returned those profile pages, because the pages themselves block direct fetch; confirm before routing.
data_gaps: YellowPages, BBB, BuildZoom, Superpages, Cylex company sub-pages, LocalSolution, MapQuest, ShowMeLocal, AllPages and the Township of Franklin's own business directory (franklintwpnj.org) mostly block automated fetching (403 / Cloudflare / Akamai bot checks). Some of these (Cylex category pages, the Somerset Garage Door Repair contact page, the Guaranteed Motor site) did load in a real browser during the revision and were read there; the rest were captured only from search-result summaries.

Fan Out Heating & Heating Co (9 Shirley Ave) could not be tied to a single operator: only one HVAC-name record sits at that address, a commercial property listing shows 9 Shirley Ave as an industrial building, and the same street address appears elsewhere under a different HVAC name. Dropped rather than kept with an unresolved name.
The Internet Archive (including the Wayback CDX API) was offline during the original pass, so cached township directory pages could not be recovered.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API endpoints did not respond (fetch failure / timeout), so no OSM bulk extraction was possible.
Google Maps served only a limited (~10 result) view per query without signing in and refused to paginate, so map-based coverage is a sample per category rather than exhaustive.
Bing and DuckDuckGo HTML returned unusable results or a bot challenge from this machine, which was not bypassed per task rules.
The NJ MVC auto-body facility PDF could only be read in slices, so the licensed auto-body list for 08873/08823 may be incomplete.
A Birdeye record named simply 'Roofing LLC' (1958 Washington Valley Rd, no reviews) was left out as a probable directory artefact rather than a verified business.
Angi and Yahoo Local pages for Qualitylawn Tree Service, and MerchantCircle for T & J Auto Body, were not readable in full, so their addresses and phones rest on search-result listings.
